description: Source code implementing Windows-specific HTTP authentication using SSPI, including credential handling, security context management, and challenge parsing for the Chromium project.

classes.name: HttpAuthSSPI
classes.description: Handles Windows SSPI-based HTTP authentication, including credential acquisition, security context management, and challenge processing.

classes.name: SSPILibrary
classes.description: Abstract interface for Windows SSPI security package functions.

methods.name: NeedsIdentity
methods.description: Checks if the server authentication token is empty, indicating need for identity.

methods.name: AllowsExplicitCredentials
methods.description: Indicates if explicit credentials are allowed.

methods.name: SetDelegation
methods.description: Sets the delegation type for the security context.

methods.name: ResetSecurityContext
methods.description: Resets and invalidates the current security context.

methods.name: ParseChallenge
methods.description: Parses the authentication challenge from the server.

methods.name: GenerateAuthToken
methods.description: Generates the next authentication token, handling initial and subsequent rounds.

methods.name: OnFirstRound
methods.description: Handles the first round of authentication, acquiring credentials.

methods.name: GetNextSecurityToken
methods.description: Generates the next security token for authentication.
